title: A library sample opens in the DAW already on the grid
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Sample sidecars
  `apricity export --sidecars` writes, beside each analyzed sample, an .asd the DAW reads on drag-in.

  Scenario: Export one sample
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "steady-120.wav"
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars steady-120.wav"
    Then "steady-120.wav.asd" exists beside the audio
    And reading it gives the sample's warp markers, warp mode "complex" and its tuning correction as detune
    And the output says "1 sidecar written"

  Scenario: Export a folder
    Given a folder with the analyzed samples "steady-120.wav" and "tempo-change.wav" and an unanalyzed "new.wav"
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars" on the folder
    Then each analyzed sample has an .asd beside it
    And the output lists "new.wav" as skipped: "no analysis yet; run apricity-analyze new.wav"

  Scenario: A drum stem is warped in Beats mode
    Given an analyzed drum stem "stems/steady-120/drums.wav"
    When I export its sidecar
    Then the sidecar's warp mode is "beats"

  Scenario: Export from a library
    Given a library holding the sample "fixtures/steady-120.wav"
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars fixtures/steady-120.wav --library L"
    Then an .asd is written beside the library's copy of the audio
    And the output names that path

  Scenario: Sidecars never sync and never go in git
    Given a library with an exported sidecar
    When I push the library
    Then the sidecar is not uploaded and is not listed as a difference
```

Manual check (DAW): drag `steady-120.wav` from the folder into an audio track: warp is on, the markers sit on the beats, the clip plays in time at a different set tempo with no re-warping.
